annotations.title: Send an image, video, audio, document or sticker

description:
Send media by URL: an image, video, audio clip, document or sticker.

Set exactly one recipient: `number`, `group_id`, or `contact_id`.

`url` must still be reachable when the send happens: Turbo Notify
fetches the bytes from it. A copy is kept in the organization's own
object storage afterwards when that is configured, which never blocks
the send and is not required for one.

`caption` applies to `image`, `video` and `document` only; audio and
stickers have nowhere to render one. `filename` applies to `document`
only. Pairing either with a kind that cannot carry it is rejected here,
before anything is sent.

After sending, only the caption of an image, video or document can be
changed, with `edit_media_caption`. The file itself, an audio clip and a
sticker cannot be edited: `delete_message` is the only change for them.

`mime_type` is optional and does not change how the message is sent.
The type WhatsApp receives comes from what the URL's own server serves,
so point `url` at a file that server labels correctly.

MediaKind.description: A media content type the public API accepts.
MediaKind.title: MediaKind

caption.description: Text shown with an image, video or document, up to 1024 characters. Audio and stickers cannot carry one.
caption.title: Caption

contact_id.description: Recipient contact id (`ct_…`), from `list_contacts`. A contact id belongs to one number: an id from one inbox does not address the same person in another. Set exactly one of `number`, `group_id` or `contact_id`.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

filename.description: The file name the recipient sees on a document, up to 255 characters. Documents only.
filename.title: Filename

group_id.description: Recipient group id (`grp_…`), from `list_groups`. A group id belongs to one number: an id from one inbox does not address the same group in another. Set exactly one of `number`, `group_id` or `contact_id`. Addressing a group needs a plan that includes group messaging: without it the call answers `payment_required: feature_not_available`, and retrying will not change that.
group_id.title: Group Id

idempotency_key.description: Any printable ASCII text you choose, 1 to 255 characters, for example the id of the event you are answering. Reusing it for the same number suppresses a duplicate if you retry. Without it, retrying after a timeout may deliver the message twice, and the recipient sees both.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

kind.description: What the file is: image, video, audio, document or sticker.

mime_type.description: The media's MIME type, recorded alongside the message. It does not change how the file is sent: the type WhatsApp receives comes from what the URL's own server serves. Optional.
mime_type.title: Mime Type

number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 form, digits only, country code first (e.g. `5511999999999`). Set exactly one of `number`, `group_id` or `contact_id`.
number.title: Number

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
number_alias.title: Number Alias

quoted_message_id.description: Quote an earlier message (`msg_…`) so it appears above yours. Do this only when your text depends on something said a while ago, yours or theirs; do not quote the message you are answering right now, send a normal message instead.
quoted_message_id.title: Quoted Message Id

url.description: Link to the file to send. It must still be reachable when the message goes out.
url.title: Url
